name: Memory
description: Durable memory — a numbered list of facts at a caller-selected workspace path. Pick the action with `command`: 'recall' renders the numbered list; 'remember' appends a new item; 'update' replaces item n; 'forget' removes item n. Edit by the item numbers shown in the list and, when the context label names a path, pass that same path on every edit. The operation defaults to the user's shared w/memory; default agents keep their own list at n/memory.

text.description: Item text — for 'remember' (the new item) and 'update' (the replacement).

n.description: 1-based item number — for 'update' and 'forget', as shown in the numbered list.

displayField.description: recall only: when the path holds a map of records, the entry field to show as each line (default 'text').

noteField.description: recall only: optional entry field appended after the line as a note.

output.description: recall → a numbered text block, or null when empty. remember/update/forget → a small status map (e.g. {remembered|updated|forgotten: true, n, count}).
